sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1,
to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Horizontal 6.3 kv motor Ansaldo of Forced draft fan (bearing
lubricating oil)

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed EL-husany, tested by 
eng. Tarek EL-kafafy, accepted by general director eng. Nady Mosaed, approved by 
eng. Mohamed EL-Tahawy Head sector of Shoubra EL-Kheima PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha CEPC quality control director, 
and certified by eng. AfafEbrahim El Dib, CEPC inspection & quality control 's 
head sector & MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category

Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.

Safety
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

After
 stopping to motor insure that circuit breaker of the motor is draw out .
Avoid contact with rotating parts .

Act
 with care in accordance with prescribed procedures , in handling and
 lifting this equipment .

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check the motor vibration not the exceed
60 microns .

Check that there is no abnormal noise on
the motor .

Check the bearing temp. on the Accurex in
the control room not to exceed 87 C .

sections.text:
Check the bearing temp. on the Accurex in
the control room not to exceed 87 C .

Check the bearing temp. on the Accurex in
the control room not to exceed 87 C .

Check the motor stator temp. on the
Accurex in the control room not the exceed 150 C .

Check the motor current reading of the 3
phases in the control room .
تحقق من وجود أي تسرب للزيت.

After isolation the circuit
breaker of the motor

Disconnect all cables of supply ,
protection , and the accessories .

Uncouple the motor and remove the
coupling flange .

Remove the protection devices and the
accessories of the bearing .

تفكيك المبادل الحراري الذي
يتكون من مجموعة من الأنابيب المستقيمة مرتبة في صندوق يقع في الأعلى
إطار المحرك بواسطة مقابس الرفع.

Clean the inside of the motor (the rotor
and stator), ventilation ducts and the windings by dry compressed air .

Measure insulation resistance with surge
arrestors disconnected, the insulation should be 100 MΩ or greater after
one min.

Measure the winding DC resistance , must
be the same for 3 phase windings .

Remove the bearing cap & check the
condition of the white metal and the clearances between shaft & holes ,
change the bearing if it exceeded 0.3 mm .

Remove the cover and the baffle of the
cooling fan casing and clean it .

Reassemble the heat exchanger and check
all bolts are well tightened .

Change the bearing oil (Type 
DTE26)

Connect all cables (Power supply ,
protection and accessories) .
Tighten the ground wire.

قم بتشغيل المحرك بدون تحميل لفترة كافية و
تحقق من ظروف التشغيل.

Stop the motor and couple the motor with
the fan shaft then run the motor & increase the load slowly with checking
the running conditions.
